title: General Available: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 release wave 2 (BC27)
summary: Business Central 2025 release wave 2 (BC27) is now generally available for cloud and on-premises deployments. The release includes version 27.0 with updated platform and application components, and existing customers will receive notifications about availability for their environments.
key_points: BC27 (2025 release wave 2) is now generally available, and new cloud customers sign up on it automatically
Cloud build is W1 27.0 (Platform 27.0.39966.0, Application 27.0.38460.39974); on-premises build is W1 27.0 (Platform 27.0.40210.0, Application 27.0.38460.40242)
Existing customers get email notifications when the update becomes available for them
Under the Modern Policy, on-premises version 27.x starts on Oct 1, 2025, ends on Apr 6, 2027, and is currently in support
Resources listed include the release plan, the partner deck, the Yammer feedback group, office hours and the BCApps 27.0 update

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) is generally available.
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the official general availability date and version number for the new release

quotes.text: New customers will automatically get the latest builds of Business Central 2025 rw2 (version 27).
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that new cloud customers are automatically provisioned with BC27 without manual action required

quotes.text: Business Central 2024 wave 2 (BC25): Manage environment updates more flexibly - Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the significant change in update frequency and flexibility for the previous release
